RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Greensboro, NC operates under a Council-Manager form of government, which is categorized as 'mayor_council' for this response as the Mayor is an elected member of the Council. The City Council consists of the Mayor and eight Council members. The Mayor and three Council members are elected at-large, and five Council members are elected from districts. Marikay Abuzuaiter became Mayor Pro Tem in January 2025, succeeding Yvonne Johnson. Jamilla Pinder is listed on the official city council page without a specific district, indicating an at-large role. The current terms for these officials are expected to end in 2025, with the next elections scheduled for odd-numbered years.
